tasks.short: Prepare actual sociology syllabi, assignments and handouts

steps.what: Select and capture the actual learning outcomes, sociology content, source passages, assignment requirements and course dates
inputs: Actual course requirements and timetable
Actual sociology sources and existing teaching material
outputs: Teacher-selected and captured content, source excerpts, outcomes, requirements and dates

steps.what: Fill exact course dates, identifiers, selected readings and assignment fields into native teaching-material templates
inputs: Actual exact selected fields and source records captured in s1
outputs: Draft materials with exact course fields and selected reading references

steps.what: Draft the actual syllabus explanation, assignment wording or handout from the teacher's selected content and source excerpts
inputs: Actual teacher content and source excerpts from s1
Native material structure from s2
outputs: Draft actual teaching text with source links and unresolved content gaps

loop.purpose: Assist wording of actual teacher-selected sociology material
loop.input: Actual selected content, source passages, outcomes and assignment requirements from s1
loop.output: Draft teaching text tied to supplied content and sources
loop.check: Teacher reads the entire draft and checks every substantive claim, citation, instruction and outcome against original sources in s4
loop.stop: Missing support, invented examples presented as fact or conflicting requirements stop drafting for teacher resolution; no automatic publication
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact fields use native templates in s2; the loop is only for explanatory wording that cannot be reproduced by fixed fields

steps.what: Revise and check the complete final course material for sociology accuracy, source support, learning purpose, instructions, dates and student audience
inputs: Complete actual draft material and original sources and course requirements
outputs: Exact complete checked final material and intended course audience

steps.what: Save the exact checked final course material
inputs: Exact final material checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual final course material

steps.what: Publish the exact checked course material to the intended students in the existing LMS
inputs: Exact complete material and audience checked in s4
outputs: Actual checked course material available to the intended students

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} and {LMS} material fields, with a bounded wording loop from actual content selected by the teacher. Keep sociology choices and the complete final source and instruction check human before separate save and student publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing actual teaching materials combines repeated course fields with explanatory drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates handle exact fields and a bounded drafting loop can work from actual selected source passages.
tasks.still_hard: A fluent handout can misstate a theory or create an assignment that does not test its stated learning purpose.
tasks.human_edge: Choose the sociology content and evaluate whether the actual material teaches it accurately.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: templates can reproduce exact course fields and bounded text drafting can assist source-based teaching prose when the teacher checks all meaning and references.

assumptions: This illustrative material-preparation episode has actual selected content and student publication. Shares are unmeasured and independent of the supplied time prior.
The teacher produces and captures all actual content selections, source passages, outcomes and dates in s1. No free course design, invented factual example or clean reading list is assumed.
Use native templates first. Existing field reuse and draft tools are baseline; no new gain is attributed to their runtime. Missing or unsupported content returns to teacher resolution.

The entire final material exists before s4. Changed content, dates or audience invalidate the gates. Ordinary material-publication authority is assumed; any required additional review must examine the final version and its actual labour be added.
Same-system save earns no saving. Publication is its own retained action; no student grade, performance inference, exam result or hidden notification is produced.
unknowns: Actual existing template use and teacher revision effort
research_questions: How much actual drafting remains after source selection and native templates, including full teacher correction?

already_counted.description: Actual content and source selection, remaining drafting and full final material checking remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain source context and material templates and review drafting and citation failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact entire final material checked in s4; edits invalidate the check.
Exact complete final course material and student audience checked in s4; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70; gross saving=30 from exact fields and assisted wording. Deduct 5 incremental hours once for net 25; save and publication remain retained and existing automation earns no new gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Stay current through literature, colleagues and conferences

steps.what: Find actual current sociology literature and relevant conference material using native library searches and saved filters
inputs: Actual topic interests
Existing research library and reference catalogue, defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual selected current sources and conference material

steps.what: Read and critically assess actual current literature and its implications for sociology knowledge
inputs: Actual selected source texts from s1
outputs: Human understanding and evaluation of current evidence

steps.what: Discuss actual developments and research questions with sociology colleagues
inputs: Actual developments and colleagues' evidence and questions
outputs: Actual professional discussion and clarified understanding

steps.what: Participate in actual professional conference sessions and discussion
inputs: Actual conference programme and participants
outputs: Actual participation and professional learning

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} library searches for actual current sociology sources. Keep reading, critical interpretation, colleague discussion and conference participation human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly navigating source catalogues can take effort before substantive reading begins.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved filters can locate relevant actual records without generating claims about them.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing which development matters requires understanding its actual evidence and scholarly context.
tasks.human_edge: Critically connect current work with the field and discuss its limitations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native library search filters can reduce repeated source navigation while current-literature reading and professional discussion remain human.

assumptions: Shares are an illustrative active-work mix, not measured frequency or the supplied prior. Conference waiting and travel are not counted as reducible work.
The teacher selects actual search interests and reads original sources. No model summary, free evidence review or generated conference content is assumed.
Use native searches first; existing saved searches and their runtime are baseline. No outbound search alert is automatically sent.

No actual record, report, bibliography or send is established by this staying-current task. If the observed work includes one, split and count it; do not invent a post-conversation report. Deduplicate source finding shared with actual research or material preparation.
unknowns: Actual existing library search settings and duty mix
research_questions: What actual repeated source navigation remains beyond current native searches?

already_counted.description: Remaining source finding and full actual literature reading remain counted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=95.5; gross saving=4.5. Deduct 1 incremental hour once for net 3.5. Reading, discussion and conference participation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct actual sociology research and publish its findings

steps.what: Design the actual sociology study and specify its research question, source selection, codebook and explicit analysis calculations
inputs: Actual research question and available source material
Existing research analysis and reference system, defined as OTHER
outputs: Human study design and captured explicit data and analysis rules

steps.what: Conduct the actual archival research, collect and read the actual sources and capture and verify the selected study data and references
inputs: Actual available archival sources and study design from s1
outputs: Actual researcher-produced and verified study data, source excerpts and references with gaps exposed

steps.what: Calculate the exact selected descriptive study tables using the actual captured data and explicit analysis rules
inputs: Actual captured study data from s2
Explicit selected calculations from s1
outputs: Draft reproducible study tables with source links and missing values visible

steps.what: Interpret the actual evidence and analysis to determine supported findings, competing explanations and study limitations
inputs: Actual original source evidence and calculated tables from s2-s3
outputs: Human conclusions, arguments and limits with selected supporting sources captured

steps.what: Write the actual research publication from the teacher's findings, arguments and selected source passages
inputs: Actual human findings and argument from s4
Actual sources and tables from s2-s3
outputs: Draft actual research publication with traceable claims and references

loop.purpose: Assist wording around actual researcher-produced findings
loop.input: Actual human argument, selected source passages, verified tables and limits from s2-s4
loop.output: Draft prose tied to actual findings and sources, with gaps left explicit
loop.check: Teacher reads and corrects every substantive passage, number and citation against originals and checks the entire final publication in s6
loop.stop: Unsupported claims, unresolved references or changed meaning stop drafting for human correction; no automatic publication
loop.why_not_simpler: Native reference styles and exact tables handle fixed content; the loop only assists research prose around the human argument

steps.what: Check the complete final publication for actual research meaning, evidence, references, limitations, disclosure and publication authority and destination
inputs: Complete actual publication draft and all original study evidence
Existing electronic research publication requirements
outputs: Exact complete checked final electronic publication and authorised destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked final research publication
inputs: Exact final publication checked in s6
outputs: Saved actual final publication

steps.what: Publish the exact checked findings in the selected authorised electronic research medium
inputs: Exact final publication and authorised destination checked in s6
Existing institutional electronic research repository, also defined as OTHER
outputs: Actual public electronic research publication with actual publication status

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} calculations for actual captured research data and use a bounded {DOCS} wording loop around the teacher's own argument. Retain actual research, interpretation and full final publication checking before separate save and authorised electronic publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual research publication can include repeated table construction and prose drafting after the evidence and argument exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis tools calculate explicit tables and bounded drafting can use the actual researcher-produced findings.
tasks.still_hard: Research validity and a supported sociological interpretation cannot be supplied by a fluent draft.
tasks.human_edge: Conduct the actual study and take responsibility for what its evidence supports.

ambition.what: Improve existing research analysis and publication preparation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit analysis calculations and bounded source-based drafting can support research publication while study design, evidence production and interpretation remain human.

assumptions: This representative archival study publishes actual findings in an authorised electronic research repository, an electronic medium in the statement. Shares are unmeasured and not based on the prompt prior; no blanket gain is applied to every study or journal workflow.

The teacher designs all actual analysis rules in s1 and conducts actual source collection, reading, coding and data capture in s2. No clean research dataset, completed analysis or free argument is assumed.

Use native calculations and reference styles first. Existing scripts, tables and runtime are baseline; only actual manual calculation is replaced. Missing data and source contradictions remain visible for retained human resolution.

The loop only assists wording after the teacher determines actual conclusions. All passage and citation correction stays in s5, and full final checking stays in s6; it is not an automated study, peer review or generated finding.

Ordinary authority to publish this actual version in the selected medium is required. Any required coauthor or institutional approval must inspect the complete final version and its actual labour be added before publication; changed content invalidates gates.
Save and publication earn no saving. No journal acceptance or external editorial labour is assumed; a journal episode would need its real submission, revision, approvals and release sequence instead.
unknowns: Actual manual analysis and drafting effort and publication approval route
research_questions: Observe one actual study through publication, including source capture and complete final revision, before extrapolating gains.

already_counted.description: Actual study design, source and data production, interpretation, remaining prose correction and full final publication check remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain explicit analysis and drafting context and review calculation, source and citation failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final research publication checked in s6; changes invalidate the check.
Exact complete final publication, actual authority and electronic destination checked in s6; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=79.8; gross saving=20.2 from actual manual tables and assisted wording. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 16.2. Actual research, judgement, saves and publication actions remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan, evaluate and revise actual sociology curriculum and instruction

steps.what: Read and evaluate the actual curriculum, course material, instructional evidence and learning objectives and capture selected evidence and fields
inputs: Actual current curriculum and teaching materials
Actual existing course evidence and learning objectives
outputs: Human assessment of actual teaching needs with captured source evidence and selected fixed fields

steps.what: Assemble exact selected course and curriculum fields into the native revision working document
inputs: Actual selected fields and source references captured in s1
outputs: Draft revision structure with exact selected existing course information

steps.what: Determine actual curriculum and instruction changes, weighing sociology content, learning purpose and observed teaching evidence
inputs: Actual assessment from s1 and working structure from s2
outputs: Human-selected actual changes and reasons captured for revision

steps.what: Write actual revised course content and instructional wording from the teacher's chosen changes
inputs: Actual selected changes and reasons from s3
Actual original course material and sources from s1
outputs: Draft actual revised material and change explanation

loop.purpose: Assist wording of actual teacher-selected course changes
loop.input: Actual chosen changes, existing material and supporting source passages
loop.output: Draft revised content and explanation with every change tied to the teacher's instructions
loop.check: Teacher corrects all changed meaning and checks the entire final revision against original sources and learning purpose in s5
loop.stop: Unsupported content, conflicting outcomes or unexplained changes stop for manual correction; no automatic course change takes effect
loop.why_not_simpler: Exact fields are assembled natively in s2; the loop only assists actual explanatory and instructional wording

steps.what: Check the complete final revision and explanation for sociology accuracy, learning alignment, sources, authority and intended course audience
inputs: Complete actual revision from s4 and original evidence and course requirements
outputs: Exact complete checked final course revision and authorised audience

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual course revision
inputs: Exact complete revision checked in s5
outputs: Saved actual checked revision

steps.what: Publish the exact checked authorised course revision to its intended students
inputs: Exact complete revision, authority and audience checked in s5
outputs: Actual authorised course revision available to intended students

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} and {LMS} revision fields, with a bounded wording loop for changes actually selected by the teacher. Keep evaluation, curriculum and method decisions and the complete final revision check human before separate save and authorised course publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: An actual course revision can repeat existing fields and require prose changes after its teaching decisions are made.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fields and bounded source-based drafting can support those actual changes without evaluating students or choosing the curriculum.
tasks.still_hard: Changing wording is easier than deciding whether a method or content change will address the actual learning need.
tasks.human_edge: Evaluate teaching evidence and choose justified sociology and instruction changes.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact course fields and bounded wording assistance can support actual revisions while curriculum evaluation and instructional choices remain human.

assumptions: This representative episode evaluates actual curriculum evidence and revises authorised course material. Shares are illustrative, not measured or based on the supplied prior; broader institutional curriculum decisions have their own actual approval route.

The teacher reads and captures actual evidence and fields in s1 and produces and captures all substantive revision choices in s3. No free learning evaluation or model-inferred student performance is assumed.

Native templates are tried first; existing field reuse is baseline. The loop only assists wording and preserves full human correction and final meaning checks. Missing evidence or unclear authority stops publication.

Only changes within actual teacher publication authority proceed to s7. Required institutional approval must occur on the complete final version with its real labour added; a proposed institutional curriculum change is not silently enacted by publishing course material.
The complete revision exists before s5. Edits invalidate gates; save and publication earn no saving. Deduplicate the same actual preparation and publication against 6080 rather than claiming both.
unknowns: Actual revision scope, native templates and curriculum approval route
research_questions: Observe a real revision from evidence evaluation to its actual final approval and student issue.

already_counted.description: Actual teaching evaluation, curriculum choices, remaining wording and complete final revision check remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain revision fields and drafting context and review source and change-trace failures.

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete final revision checked in s5; changes invalidate the check.
Exact entire course revision, actual publication authority and audience checked in s5; changes require renewed checking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=78; gross saving=22 from actual field reuse and assisted revision wording. Deduct 4 incremental hours once for net 18. Evaluation, decisions, save and publication remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Provide actual source passages and explicit drafting instructions
Validate exact analysis rules independently of prose
Check complete final materials and publication authority before issue
role.ambitious_version: A sociology teacher reduces repetitive fields, tables and wording work while retaining substantive teaching design, actual research, interpretation and complete final publication checks.
